newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UNHCR urges Swiss not to expel Bosnian refugees.
newsitem.headline: UNHCR urges Swiss not to expel Bosnian refugees.

text.p: The United Nations refugee agency (UNHCR) expressed concern on Tuesday at Switzerland's plan to send thousands of Bosnian refugees back home.

Spokeswoman Pamela O'Toole said UNHCR urged the government to take into account the fact that many could not return because their homes were in areas controlled by other, usually hostile ethnic groups.

The Swiss cabinet on Monday reiterated its decision to press ahead with the repatriation. It defended its policy of giving financial aid to refugees who leave voluntarily and holding out the prospect of deportation for those who refuse to do so.
O'Toole, quoting UNHCR data, said Switzerland hosted 25,000 displaced Bosnians, the majority under temporary protection.
